data.long_meaning: The name Dewansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘deva’ (god) and ‘ansh’ (abode, or part of). This name is often given to a child who is born in a divine or sacred atmosphere. The name Dewansh carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dewansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
